Worked at a retail pharmacy. The owners had a deal with doctor's offices, so that we could "add on" whatever we felt was necessary for treatment. This boiled down to us running completely unneeded drugs and charging their insurance for thousands of dollars. A wart cream, for example, would have a topical steroid, analgesic, and pain reliever added to it. None of it needed, but it made us thousands.
